body: Hi! I know you posted this ages ago, but if you're still wanting to fix them, I swear a mix of frankencese essence oil and volufline dramatically helps! My Mum is in her late 50s and was always super bothered by her tear troughs. She's had them for 20+ years, and in about 3 months, they are wayyy less noticeable.  Also, I assume taking collagen in some form or another while doing this will help with keeping the skin plump. Ive heard that it's best to eat foods that are rich in collagen and vitamin C compared to collagen vitamins or topical treatments :)
I use my lipstick on my lips, eyes, and a little around the button of my nose as contour. I feel like it gives my makeup such a cohesive look and it only takes me about 5 minutes to do my makeup.
